Episode 1

Houkago no Marionette

Episode 2

Yume no Youna
It all seemed as if it were a dream...
I went to get the DVD from my friend's house when it suddenly began raining. His mother greeted me and invited me in, saying I needed to take a bath before I caught a cold. She joined me and I was unable to help myself, she had her way with me and showed me the pleasures of a woman.
